ModbusCmd.Title: Actual position
ModbusCmd.HintText:
The actual ventilation position of the drive can be read via this value. (referred to ventilation stroke)
[%] Position CLOSED: 0 Position OPEN: ≥ 100

ModbusCmd.Title: Condition code
ModbusCmd.HintText:
The Drive group condition code can be read via this value.
Possible condition-code are listed in the ACB planning manual.

ModbusCmd.Title: Current
ModbusCmd.HintText:
The current of complete opening drive group except lock drives can be read via this value.
[mA] (±50 mA)

ModbusCmd.Title: Voltage
ModbusCmd.HintText:
The supply voltage of the drive group can be read via this value.
[mV]

ModbusCmd.Title: Nominal control command
ModbusCmd.HintText:
The nominal control command of the drive can be written via this value.
Stop: 0 CLOSED: 1 OPEN: 2 Ventilation position: 6 None (without change): 31

ModbusCmd.Title: Nominal position
ModbusCmd.HintText:
The nominal ventilation position of the drive can be written via this value.
[0 - 100 %]

ModbusCmd.Title: Target speed
ModbusCmd.HintText:
The target speed of the drive can be written via this value.
[mm/s]
